---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for xAPI Statement Monitor
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem or limitation you're running into. Good feature requests start with the *why*, not the *what*.

Example: "When I need to investigate a completion failure for a specific course, I have to scroll through hundreds of statements in the Live Feed. There's no way to filter by course without also filtering by user."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like to see. Be as specific as you can.

Example: "Add a 'Course' filter dropdown to the Live Feed tab that limits the statement list to a selected LearnDash course."

## Alternatives Considered

Have you tried any workarounds? Are there other ways this problem could be solved? Describe any alternatives you've considered.

## Who Would Benefit

Describe the use case and who would benefit from this feature. Is this specific to a certain hosting environment, authoring tool, or workflow?

## Would You Help Implement It?

- [ ] I'm willing to submit a pull request for this feature
- [ ] I can help test it but can't write the code
- [ ] I'm just requesting it

## Additional Context

Any other context, screenshots, or examples that would help clarify the request.
